notes.title: Latest Update on Deck Casters!
notes.content:
Hey Guys & Gals !

Check out the Stream to our Lovely Streamers & a great shout-out! to 
Dogholeee “개구멍” from Korea for picking up our game:
https://www.twitch.tv/videos/228938031 

[u]Players Comments:[/u]
네메시즈 (jhp5251):뭔가 분위기가 옛날 전략겜 느낌나서 구수하네요ㅋㅋㅋ 
"It feels like the atmosphere of an old strategy game."

태덕 (ysm5427):cc도 있구나 갓겜~! 
"There is crowd control too!"

===================================================

First of All, We like to say a Big Thank You to our game Players in JANUARY 2018 ver.1 who give us such valuable feedbacks and comments which are awesome!
 
Seconds later, after reviewing the valid and sound feedbacks pointed out by the Players, the team dive right into working on the new features which we like to credit the Players' feedbacks and we have included your features into newly updated FEBRUARY 2018 ver.2 !
 
[b][u]FEBRUARY 2018 ver.2 New Features Added since Launch:[/u][/b]
- Steam Achievements.
- Added Full In-game Tutorial for the PC controls.
- Added Customizable controls for Players to set their own preferred keys.
- Added a new Lan Feature option for players who prefer playing on Local networks.

We appreciate all your inputs on how to improve the game which show us you care about our game, and this matters a lot to us as it motivates and encourage us to keep us going forward.
 
And most importantly, we hope to achieve a fair level playing field where there is no Micro transactions, or Pay to Win, so everyone can have fun, have a good time, and enjoy the game together.

Cheers
The Rock Nano Global Team, 
who is here to chill together as a clan with you all!

notes.title: Patch 18/01/2018
notes.content:
Greetings Deck Casters!

It’s the first Patch of Deck Casters and we want to show that this game has the potential to be fun to play with your friends.

After reviewing the first week of feedback from the reviews, the team went straight to work on several new features that players have been talking about.

[b][u]New Features in the Patch[/u][/b]
- Added Customizable controls for Players to set their own preferred keys.
- Added a new Lan Feature option for players who prefer playing on Local networks.

[b][u]Upcoming[/u][/b]
- The team is now looking at a possible in-game tutorial for the PC controls.
- Achievements.
- Cloud Saves.

Cheers
The Rock Nano Global Team
